title: Investigating the Viability of Employing Multi-modal Large Language Models in the Context of Audio Deepfake Detection
claim: Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct and SALMONN perform poorly at deepfake detection zero-shot and fail out-of-domain; in-domain fine-tuning with minimal supervision works.
not_covered: Detection accuracy only; no matched real/clone pairs; no behavioural outcome; no comparison of detection with downstream treatment.

title: HoliAntiSpoof: Audio LLM for Holistic Speech Anti-Spoofing
claim: First ALLM framework casting anti-spoofing as text generation over method, attributes and semantic impact; DailyTalkEdit benchmark; in-context learning helps OOD.
not_covered: Trained detector, not an audit of off-the-shelf assistants; no behavioural provenance delta.

title: Audio Language Model for Deepfake Detection Grounded in Acoustic Chain-of-Thought
claim: CoLMbo-DF injects textual acoustic features into the prompt so a small ALLM reasons over evidence; beats ALLM baselines; releases CoT-annotated pairs.
not_covered: Fine-tuned detection; nothing on zero-shot deployed models or implicit behavioural sensitivity.

title: Interpretable All-Type Audio Deepfake Detection with Audio LLMs via Frequency-Time Reinforcement Learning
claim: Binary-label SFT makes ALLMs black boxes and vanilla RFT hallucinates rationales; FT-GRPO on ~340K frequency-time CoT gives SOTA all-type detection with grounded rationales.
not_covered: Training method; no evaluation of untuned model behaviour; speech is one of four audio types.

title: Towards Explicit Acoustic Evidence Perception in Audio LLMs for Speech Deepfake Detection
claim: Audio-LLM detectors are biased toward semantic cues and miss fine acoustic artefacts; fakes with natural semantics bypass them; adding structured spectrograms restores acoustic access.
not_covered: Semantic dominance shown for detection only; no same-speaker same-words pairs; no judge or assistant outcomes.

title: ThinkOmni: A Reasoning-Driven Omni-Modal LLM Framework for Audio Forgery Detection and Localization
claim: Omni-modal LLM with 100K forensic CoT, modality-incremental learning and multi-task loss; joint detection and temporal localisation with cross-dataset generalisation.
not_covered: Trained forensic system; no audit of deployed assistants; no behavioural outcomes.

title: SARA: Stress Test Reasoning in Audio Deepfake Detection
claim: Five open ALMs under acoustic and linguistic attacks; acoustic attacks cut reasoning-verdict coherence 14.2%; trace coherence detects perturbed audio at 0.78 F1 without the waveform.
not_covered: Reasoning faithfulness of detectors; no provenance effect on non-detection tasks; no clone pairs.

title: TriDF: Evaluating Perception, Detection, and Hallucination for Interpretable DeepFake Detection
claim: 16 deepfake types across image/video/audio on frontier MLLMs; audio: SALMONN-7B most accurate with no interpretability, Gemini 2.5-Pro detection nearly at chance with best explanations.
not_covered: Detection only; generic forgeries not same-speaker clones; no behavioural task. Closest closed-model number for the explicit probe baseline.

title: MADBench: A Benchmark for Modality-Aware Audio Deepfake Detection
claim: Separates speech from environmental-audio forgery; benchmarks detectors and multimodal LLMs; synthetic speech harder to detect than manipulated background audio; pretrained detectors fail on both.
not_covered: Detection on video-borne audio; no LALM behavioural outcome; no matched clone-vs-real pairs.

title: SpeechFake: A Large-Scale Multilingual Speech Deepfake Dataset Incorporating Cutting-Edge Generation Methods
claim: 3M+ samples, 3000+ h, 40 generators (TTS, VC, neural vocoder), 46 languages; ablations on generation method, language and speaker variation.
not_covered: Dedicated detectors, not LALMs; no behavioural or judge outcomes; vocoder partition is the nearest precedent for a RESYNTH arm.

title: CodecFake+: Codec-Based Resynthesized Data as a Proxy for Detecting CodecFake Speech
claim: Codec re-synthesised speech from 31 open codecs is a valid training proxy for detecting codec-based TTS; codec taxonomy predicts detectability.
not_covered: Detector training; no LALM behaviour. Establishes that codec round-trips carry detectable artefacts, motivating the RESYNTH control.

title: Eroding Trust in Real Speech: A Large-Scale Study of Human Audio Deepfake Perception
claim: 35,532 judgments, 1,768 listeners, 138 systems: human accuracy on fakes flat (72.9 to 71.2%) but on real speech fell 72.7 to 64.1%; LM-based and commercial TTS hardest; ML detector >94.5%.
not_covered: Humans, not models; no LALM. Human comparator for the explicit probe and the real-speech-penalised framing.

title: Walking Through Uncertainty: An Empirical Study of Uncertainty Estimation for Audio-Aware Large Language Models
claim: First systematic uncertainty-estimation study for ALLMs across five methods; semantic and verification methods beat token-level on reasoning but rankings become model- and benchmark-dependent on hallucination/unanswerable settings.
not_covered: No provenance or deepfake task; no matched pairs. Shows probe confidence cannot be read at face value.

title: HalluAudio: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Hallucination Detection in Large Audio-Language Models
claim: 5K+ human-verified QA over speech, sound, music; measures hallucination rate, yes/no bias, error type and refusal rate; broad acoustic-grounding deficiencies.
not_covered: No synthetic-vs-real axis. Its yes/no-bias and refusal protocol is the template for scoring a binary provenance probe.

title: ParaPairAudioBench: Paralinguistic Pairwise Audio Benchmark for LALM-as-a-Judge
claim: 5,175 pairs over style, rate, emphasis, age, gender; LALM judges trail humans by 32 points with severe calibration failures on ties; same-transcript vs cross-transcript conditions separate lexical from acoustic reliance.
not_covered: Judges paralinguistics, not provenance; no real-vs-clone pairs. Same-transcript design is the precedent for content-fixed pairs.

title: Senses Wide Shut: A Representation-Action Gap in Omnimodal LLMs
claim: IMAVB 500 clips: hidden states reliably encode premise-perception mismatches while outputs almost never reject the false claim; audio worse than vision; prompt-resistant; probe-guided logit adjustment helps.
not_covered: Premise conflicts, not provenance; no clone pairs. Conceptual template for implicit-without-explicit.

title: Heard but Not Heeded: Paralinguistic Information Encoding and Loss in Audio-Language Models
claim: Speaking style is strongly encoded in late encoder layers of Whisper, Qwen2-Audio, Qwen2.5-Omni, Chroma but degraded before output; models split into content-driven vs acoustic-driven; leakage metric quantifies encode-vs-use gap.
not_covered: Speaking style, not synthetic-ness; no behavioural task. Supplies mechanism story for family-dependent sign.

title: ParaBridge: Bridging Paralinguistic Perception and Dialogue Behavior in Speech Language Models
claim: SLMs recognise paralinguistic cues but ignore them in dialogue; an inference-time scaffold narrows the perception-behaviour gap, so cues are latent; self-distillation makes it stable (VoxSafeBench SAR 14.6 to 40.3%).
not_covered: Cues are child voice, fear, noise, not provenance; no real-vs-clone comparison.

title: Language Models Fail to Introspect About Their Knowledge of Language
claim: Across 21 LLMs, prompted metalinguistic answers do not predict the model's own string probabilities beyond a near-identical model: no privileged self-access; prompted responses are not internal knowledge.
not_covered: Text-only, grammaticality. Cited as the reason an explicit probe is a different measurement from a behavioural delta.

title: Audio Large Language Models Can Be Descriptive Speech Quality Evaluators
claim: Most audio LLMs are unaware of the quality of speech they process; first natural-language quality corpus from human MOS; ALLD alignment reaches MSE 0.17 MOS and 98.6% A/B accuracy.
not_covered: Quality, not provenance; requires alignment training. Motivates grading as a channel where synthetic artefacts could leak.

title: From Senses to Decisions: The Information Flow of Auditory and Visual Perception in Multimodal LLMs
claim: Traces audio/visual token routing in Qwen2.5-Omni and Video-SALMONN2 Plus; audio contribution scales with task reliance; tokens droppable after transfer to the LLM with little loss.
not_covered: Routing interpretability; no provenance axis. Tooling precedent for a mechanistic follow-up.
